description.value: Five Guys on Robson Street is a well-known American-style burger chain in the heart of downtown Vancouver, offering extensively customizable burgers, hot dogs, fresh-cut fries double-cooked in peanut oil, and over 1,000 milkshake combinations. The restaurant uses fresh (never frozen) beef and hand-prepares ingredients daily, providing a calorie-dense refueling option for cyclists riding through the city centre. Both indoor seating and takeout are available, and the location is confirmed open.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 53m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 64m; stands (2 spaces) at 71m; stands (2 spaces) at 83m; stands (2 spaces) at 84m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Five Guys website at https://restaurants.fiveguys.ca/635-robson-street fully corroborates the OSM address (635 Robson Street, Vancouver, BC V6B 5J3), phone number (604) 685-1585, and open status ('Our Robson St. location is now open!'). The website confirms takeout service under 'Services Available' and its FAQ states the veggie sandwich 'is not a veggie burger' with no vegetarian protein substitute, consistent with OSM's diet:vegetarian=no tag. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears in either the OSM tags or the website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Five Guys Robson St. is a confirmed-open, high-calorie food stop in central Vancouver with takeout service; while no cycling-specific amenities are confirmed, it is a practical refueling option for touring cyclists on a major urban corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website FAQ confirms 'Our veggie sandwich is not a veggie burger' — it consists of condiments and cheese only, with no vegetarian protein substitute
